scripts.deploy: bun run db:migrate && bun run web:build && cf deploy
scripts.db:migrate: cf d1 migrations apply $(bun scripts/d1-id.ts) --dir drizzle --pattern 'drizzle/*/migration.sql'
scripts.db:migrate:local: cf d1 migrations apply $(bun scripts/d1-id.ts) --local --dir drizzle --pattern 'drizzle/*/migration.sql'
scripts.db:migrate:hosted: cf d1 migrations apply $(bun scripts/d1-id.ts hosted) --dir drizzle --pattern 'drizzle/*/migration.sql'
